title: Smith Repository Configuration
description: Configuration for a Smith repository, stored at .smith/repo.yml

version.description: File-format version. Always 1 for this schema.

name.description: Repository name. Required; identifies the monorepo.

registries.description: Registry sources, in priority order: first match wins when a type or template exists in more than one registry.

tools.description: Tools required repo-wide, checked by smith doctor against PATH (BYOT).

project_roots.description: Directories Smith traverses to find projects. Smith never looks outside these roots.

items.description: Relative path from repo root; no absolute paths, no '..'

name.description: Registry name. Must be unique across the registries list (enforced by smith, not by this schema).

source.description: A registry source: either a git URL or a local filesystem path (dev only).

git.description: Git URL to clone/pull (https or ssh).

path.description: Local directory, read in place; dev escape hatch.
